klaim.bukti: Eight depth cameras varying in operational principle [...] were compared in context of use for in-orchard fruit localization and sizing. For this application, a specification on bias-corrected root mean square error of 20 mm for a camera-to-fruit distance of 2 m
klaim.catatan: Delapan kamera dan spesifikasi RMSE terkoreksi bias 20 mm sesuai; spesifikasi berlaku pada jarak kamera-buah 2 m dan kondisi sinar matahari, kualifikasi itu tidak disebut di naskah tetapi tidak mengubah makna.

klaim.bukti: most SfM and visual SLAM techniques operate based on the assumption that the observed environment is static. [...] we present for the first time a survey of visual SLAM and SfM techniques that are targeted toward operation in dynamic environments.
klaim.catatan: Abstrak mendukung asumsi adegan statis dan keberadaan metode adegan dinamis. Bagian tentang gerak dedaunan adalah pernyataan naskah sendiri, bukan atribusi ke kajian ini.

klaim.bukti: we present for the first time a survey of visual SLAM and SfM techniques that are targeted toward operation in dynamic environments. We identify three main problems: how to perform reconstruction (robust visual SLAM), how to segment and track dynamic objects
klaim.catatan: Kajian ini adalah survei SLAM visual dan SfM (rekonstruksi 3D) di luar pertanian; abstrak tidak memuat bukti pertanian.

klaim.halaman: Abstrak, h. 1; Bagian 2, h. 2; Gambar 2, h. 4
klaim.bukti: Following the core principles of the PRISMA guidelines, this systematic review summarizes recent domestic and international studies on orchard yield estimation and compares machine vision, remote sensing, and multi-source data fusion methods
klaim.catatan: Topik, sumbu pengorganisasian menurut sumber data (Bagian 3 visi mesin, 4 pengindraan jauh spektral, 5 fusi data), dan PRISMA sesuai. Sumber menulis mengikuti 'core principles' PRISMA dan memuat diagram alir PRISMA 2020. Identitas lintas pandang bukan sumbu pengorganisasian; pelacakan hanya dibahas sebagai subbagian penghitungan berbasis video.

klaim.bukti: merging the two side-views is difficult due to the lack of overlap between the two partial reconstructions. Our first main contribution in this paper is a novel method that utilizes global features and semantic information to obtain an initial solution aligning the two sides.
klaim.catatan: Sesuai. Sumber menyebut 'lack of overlap' dan 'nearly no overlap', sejalan dengan 'share little overlap'.
